readback.body: Stages and verifies the governed five-file JOPE/Lime model bundle, packages it into CPU/GPU SageMaker and cloud images, enables JOPE, and preserves GPU-first runtime dispatch with CPU fallback. Includes the deploy lock determinism fix and runtime inventory module split. Required, security, artifact-support, coverage, and Jankurai score evidence were run at the exact head; full image build remains fail-closed until SmartCluster tag, handler hashes, and disk policy are satisfied.
readback.title: release(deploy): stage GPU model bundle assets
